extracted.intended_audience: general newspaper readers interested in international wartime news (circa 1940)
extracted.subtask_description: A historical news article reporting international political, military, and economic developments during wartime, synthesizing dispatches (AP) about diplomacy, military movements, trade controls, and civilian measures. Intended to inform a general readership of current events and official actions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Treatment of prisoners under 1929 Geneva agreement
rubrics_metrics.description: In supervising the treatment of prisoners the United States is acting under a 1929 agreement signed at Geneva by all the leading nations ... It guarantees that prisoners shall not be mistreated or forced to give information, must be permitted to write letters home, cannot be compelled to work on military objectives and must be paid like civilian employees on civilian work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The item lists specific protections: no mistreatment; no coercion to give information; right to write letters home; no compulsory work on military objectives; must be paid as civilian employees when doing civilian work. The U.S. appealed to supervise treatment under that agreement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Egypt restriction on removal of private wealth
rubrics_metrics.description: The Government today banned the removal of wealth from Egypt ... Now no persons may take away more than twenty Egyptian pounds (currently about $65).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A government administrative order limiting the amount of cash/assets individuals may remove from the country (explicit monetary ceiling). Context: aimed at preventing capital flight by Italians fearing imminent hostilities or expulsion.

rubrics_metrics.name: International Rubber Regulation Committee export quotas and permit requests
rubrics_metrics.description: The International Rubber Regulation Committee today fixed the export quotas the same as the quota for the current quarter. In addition the committee requested governments of rubber-producing areas to issue as soon as possible export permits for the whole period covered by the announcement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Operational details included: quotas kept unchanged for the next quarter; governments urged to issue permits covering the entire announced period. (Elsewhere the text notes quotas for the last six months of the year set at 80% of basic quotas.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Exchange of civilian prisoners via Swiss Red Cross
rubrics_metrics.description: France and Germany carried out their second exchange of civilian prisoners through the Swiss Red Cross today, ninety-two French nationals returned to France by way of Geneva, Germans returned to Reichenhausen.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes the neutral intermediary and mechanism for exchanging civilian internees/civilians: using the Swiss Red Cross as the channel for negotiated transfers between belligerents. Implies an accepted practice/procedure for civilian exchanges in wartime.
